scope:
Measure a complete experimental FAP3 disk with the real Fuse/TR-DOS.

Records actual publication OUTs, every AY register write/tick, all runtime
sector bytes and deterministic pixel samples per frame. Samples are not a
full image comparison. No synthetic disk producer or IRQ is used.

elapsed_timing.includes: all elapsed CPU/ROM/disk/IRQ/ULA time from PLAYER entry to finished; excludes BASIC loading PLAYER and human disk changes

invariants: direct ROM return followed by EI

listing.instruction: PUSH AF / RET when all input loaded

streaming_input.scope: Instruction listings count deterministic CPU only; full physical timing requires Fuse
